_about: Golden evaluation set for the keyword/concept matcher (assets/match.js). Each case lists the section(s) a lawyer would expect to see; the case passes if one of them is within the first `top` results (default 3). `none` = the matcher should return nothing. Sets 'blind-1..3' were written before the dictionary was tuned on them; their first-pass scores are recorded in docs/EVALUATION.md.
